lines.speaker: camp_clerk
lines.text: Two payrolls. One has four hundred and six names on it and goes to the accountants. The other has a number in the same box and goes somewhere I can't see.

lines.speaker: camp_clerk
lines.text: Same number, same weeks, same hours. So either four hundred and six people are being paid twice, or there's a second crew on this site that I have never once seen eat.

lines.speaker: camp_clerk
lines.text: The foreman signs both. I'd like to know what the second column is for, and I'd like to still have this job on Friday.

choices.text: We'll ask the foreman. Stay in the trailer.
Some columns are better left alone.
